sources.snippet: Badger setts are ventilated by their many entrances. Air enters the lower tunnels and leaves through the higher ones, so a sett breathes without any chimney. Chambers sit off the main tunnels and are lined with dry bedding that the badgers air out on warm mornings. Badger setts are ventilated by their many entrances.
